event_selection.partial_occlusion: contiguous official occlusion=1 run, bracketed by annotated target frames
event_selection.temporary_complete_disappearance: 2-90 frame internal GT gap bracketed by the same target ID
event_selection.camera_motion_or_blur: sequence-relative bottom-10% Laplacian sharpness or top-10% phase-correlation motion run

models.sam3_native_id_refinement: Original SAM 3; native text-grounded obj_id refined at the pre-event GT center

evaluation.frame_recall: same native obj_id IoU>=0.5 matches divided by visible target GT frames
evaluation.recovery_rate: eligible events where the same native obj_id matches within the recovery window
